questions.q:
Consider the following pairs of a report or data source and its publisher:
1. Annual Survey of India's City Systems : Observer Research Foundation
2. Global Human Settlements Layer : European Commission
3. Integrated Ocean Carbon Research report : Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of UNESCO
4. Global Gender Gap Report : World Economic Forum
How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?
questions.e: Pairs 2, 3 and 4 are right. The Commission's satellite-based layer shows India as far more urban than the Census suggests, the Paris-based IOC issued the ocean carbon report, and the Forum publishes the annual gender gap rankings. Pair 1 is wrong: the city-systems survey comes from the Janaagraha Foundation, a Bengaluru body studying urban governance, and not from a foreign-policy think tank.
questions.s: Vision IAS pp. 8-11, 78; publisher table in the glossary

questions.q:
Match the following reports or data sets with the body responsible for them:
List-I
A. Devolution Index 2024
B. Business Ready, successor to Doing Business
C. Forced-displacement figures
D. Forest-fire incident data
List-II
1. Ministry of Panchayati Raj
2. Forest Survey of India
3. UNHCR
4. World Bank
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
questions.e: The Devolution Index measures how far powers and funds reach panchayats, so it comes from the Ministry of Panchayati Raj. Business Ready replaced the discontinued Doing Business rankings at the World Bank. UNHCR, the UN refugee agency, compiles displacement data. The Forest Survey of India, under the environment ministry, reports satellite-based fire alerts, which is the source of the incident figures quoted this month.
questions.s: Vision IAS pp. 11-13, 33-35, 97-100; Shankar IAS pp. 60-62; B-READY succession is static

questions.q:
With reference to the publishers of well-known global indices, consider the following statements:
1. The Corruption Perceptions Index is published by the World Bank.
2. The Human Development Report is published by the World Bank.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Neither is correct. Transparency International, a Berlin-based non-government organisation, publishes the Corruption Perceptions Index, although it draws on assessments from external sources. The Human Development Report comes from the United Nations Development Programme, which introduced the index in 1990. The World Bank has its own products, such as Business Ready. These bodies publish so many rankings that the attribution of each is regularly tested.
questions.s: Vision IAS p. 16; TI base and UNDP report are static

questions.q:
With reference to central funding for tribal areas, consider the following statements:
1. Special Central Assistance to the Tribal Sub-Scheme began only in 2017.
2. Grants under the proviso to Article 275(1) are meant to raise the level of administration in Scheduled Areas and promote tribal welfare.
3. These grants are charged on the Consolidated Fund of India.
4. The Special Area Programme under this head provides 100 per cent grants.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Statements 2, 3 and 4 are correct. Article 275 grants are charged expenditure, unlike ordinary votes of Parliament. Statement 1 is wrong because the assistance began in 1977-78 as Special Central Assistance to the Tribal Sub-Plan; 2017 was merely a renaming after Plan and Non-Plan expenditure were merged. It remains additive to line ministry and State schemes, and covers North-Eastern States too.
questions.s: Shankar IAS pp. 20-22; charged status under Article 275 is static

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs of a scheme or programme and the body running or anchoring it:
1. Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission : Ministry of Tribal Affairs through TRIFED
2. UDAN : Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
3. Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0 : DPIIT
4. National Monetisation Pipeline 2.0 : NITI Aayog
How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?
questions.e: Pairs 1, 3 and 4 are right. TRIFED delivers the tribal livelihood mission, DPIIT anchors startup support, and NITI Aayog prepared the asset-monetisation plan. Pair 2 is wrong because UDAN, for regional air connectivity, is under the Ministry of Civil Aviation. The word 'connectivity' tempts a link to roads, but its purpose is to make flights on underserved regional routes affordable.
questions.s: Shankar IAS pp. 20-22; Vision IAS pp. 33-67; Shankar IAS pp. 54-57

questions.q: The Economic Survey 2025-26 cited a negative 'Power Gap' score for India. Such a score is best understood to mean that:
o: India's actual influence in Asia falls short of what its resources would predict
India's defence spending is lower than that of its immediate neighbours combined
India's influence in Asia exceeds what its resources would predict
India's score on the Asia Power Index has fallen every year since the index began
questions.e: The Power Gap is a secondary analysis that compares a country's influence with the influence its resources would be expected to bring. The Survey used India's negative score to argue that it operates below its full strategic potential. A positive score would mean influence above resources. The measure is not a comparison of military budgets, and it does not trace a year-on-year decline.
questions.s: Vision IAS p. 28

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: PM JANMAN is targeted specifically at households and habitations of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups.
Statement-II: The Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan combines 25 interventions implemented by 17 line Ministries.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is not correct
Statement-I is not correct but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Both are correct, but the second does not explain the first because they describe different schemes. PM JANMAN is a time-bound three-year push for the most vulnerable groups, covering housing, water, roads and electrification. Dharti Aaba is a wider five-year convergence effort across tribal villages in 30 States and UTs. One is narrow and deep, the other broad, a contrast often blurred.
questions.s: Shankar IAS pp. 20-22

questions.q:
With reference to bodies publishing data on social issues, consider the following statements:
1. The National Crime Records Bureau conducts the Periodic Labour Force Survey.
2. The National Crime Records Bureau functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 2 is correct. The Bureau compiles police-recorded crime data, including the dowry figures cited this month, and publishes the annual Crime in India. Statement 1 is wrong as the labour survey belongs to the statistics ministry and its National Statistics Office. Keep in mind that police-recorded data reflect reporting, so a rise can show greater reporting as well as increased incidence.
questions.s: Vision IAS pp. 81-83; NCRB ministry is static

questions.q:
Match the following with the Ministry primarily responsible:
List-I
A. World's Largest Grain Storage Plan in the Cooperative Sector
B. National Food Security Act, 2013
C. Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme
D. Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
List-II
1. Ministry of Cooperation
2. Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
3. Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
4. Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
questions.e: The storage plan works at primary agricultural credit society level and belongs to the Ministry of Cooperation, though it converges with farm schemes. The food security law is handled by the department of food and public distribution. The electronics component scheme belongs to MeitY, and the Fund, begun in 2020, is an agriculture ministry credit tool whose target is to be doubled for grain storage.
questions.s: Vision IAS pp. 33-67; Shankar IAS pp. 54-57

questions.q: 'Corporate Mitras', announced in the Union Budget 2026-27 for micro and small enterprises, would be developed with the help of which of the following?
o: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs' Serious Fraud Investigation Office
The Reserve Bank of India and scheduled commercial banks
The Securities and Exchange Board of India and stock exchanges
Professional institutes of chartered accountants, company secretaries and cost accountants
questions.e: ICAI, ICSI and ICMAI, the bodies for chartered accountants, company secretaries and cost accountants, are the link, since small firms need accessible, affordable compliance help. The Reserve Bank is connected with the separate TReDS platform for receivables. SEBI regulates markets, and the fraud office investigates corporate fraud, so neither fits a support role for small enterprises.
questions.s: Vision IAS pp. 33-67; Shankar IAS pp. 54-57; expansion of ICAI, ICSI and ICMAI is static

questions.q:
With reference to Eklavya Model Residential Schools, consider the following statements:
1. Schools earlier funded under Article 275(1) grants were excluded from the new model and left with the States.
2. The new model provides for a school in every block having over 50 per cent ST population and at least 20,000 tribal persons.
3. They aim at an education on par with Navodaya Vidyalayas.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. Block-level criteria based on the 2011 Census target areas of high tribal concentration, and the Navodaya benchmark sets the quality aim in the children's own environment. Statement 1 is wrong as the 288 schools funded earlier under Article 275(1) are being upgraded to the new model, which brings the total target to 728 and about 3.5 lakh ST students.
questions.s: Shankar IAS pp. 20-22

questions.q: The Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission was formed by merging schemes relating to:
o: forest rights cells and land-title digitisation
Article 275 grants and Special Central Assistance
marketing of Minor Forest Produce through MSP, and institutional support for marketing tribal products
questions.e: The Mission combined the MSP-based mechanism and value-chain scheme for Minor Forest Produce with institutional support for marketing tribal products. It seeks entrepreneurship and livelihoods through self-managed use of resources, and it funds States to set up Van Dhan Vikas Kendras for value addition. The other pairings are separate streams of tribal education, area funding and rights, and they were not merged here.
questions.s: Shankar IAS pp. 20-22

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: The Economic Survey and the Annual Financial Statement are both prepared under the Ministry of Finance.
Statement-II: Article 112 of the Constitution requires the Economic Survey to be laid before Parliament each year.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is not correct
Statement-I is not correct but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Statement I is correct, but Statement II is not. Article 112 concerns the Annual Financial Statement, which is the constitutional name for the Budget. The Survey is not a constitutional requirement; it is an annual review prepared by the Economic Division under the Chief Economic Adviser. The Survey for 2025-26 offered a phased AI roadmap and discussed the idea of an 'Entrepreneurial State'.
questions.s: Vision IAS pp. 46-47; Article 112 and CEA role are static

questions.q:
Under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, about 30 lakh households have rooftop systems. Consider the following statements:
1. In a RESCO model, a third-party service company owns the system and the consumer pays for the energy or service.
2. One Model Solar Village per district is a feature of the scheme.
3. Urban local bodies and panchayats are excluded from scheme incentives.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The RESCO route reduces upfront cost for the household, which is why the scheme offers a payment security mechanism to developers. Model villages demonstrate adoption in rural areas. Statement 3 is wrong because the scheme gives incentives to both urban local bodies and panchayati raj institutions, relying on local government to promote installations, alongside a national portal for applications.
questions.s: Vision IAS p. 104; RESCO description is static

questions.q:
With reference to the National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation, consider the following statements:
1. It is a Government company under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs.
2. It is licensed as a not-for-profit company, now under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013.
3. It lends only to State Governments and does not fund individual ST entrepreneurs.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The Corporation, set up in 2001 exclusively for the economic development of Scheduled Tribes, was licensed under Section 25 of the 1956 Act, and that provision corresponds to Section 8 now. Statement 3 is wrong as its main role is to provide loans to ST entrepreneurs. It should be told apart from TRIFED, which focuses on marketing tribal produce.
questions.s: Shankar IAS pp. 20-22

questions.q:
With reference to food security measures noted among schemes in the news, consider the following statements:
1. The National Food Security Act, 2013 covers up to 90 per cent of the rural population and 75 per cent of the urban population.
2. Fortified rice under government programmes is enriched only with Vitamin C.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Neither is correct. The Act covers up to 75 per cent of the rural population and 50 per cent of the urban population, and this works out at about two-thirds of the country, or 81.35 crore beneficiaries. Fortification in government rice uses iron, folic acid and Vitamin B12 to address anaemia and micronutrient gaps, and it was scaled up in phases after pilots began in 2019.
questions.s: Vision IAS pp. 33-67; Shankar IAS pp. 54-57; coverage ratios and fortificants are static

questions.q: The Development Action Plan for Scheduled Tribes is best described as a mechanism in which:
o: Scheduled Tribes in each State receive direct monthly cash transfers from the Centre
the Ministry of Tribal Affairs alone receives a separate fund for all tribal sectors
a statutory council of tribal representatives sanctions projects in each Scheduled Area
Union Ministries and Departments earmark part of their scheme budgets each year for tribal development
questions.e: Besides the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, 41 Ministries and Departments set aside a share of their budgets for education, health, agriculture, roads, housing and related needs, with the aim of narrowing the gap between tribal and other communities. So it is a budget-earmarking strategy across government, and not a single ministry's fund, a cash transfer scheme or a statutory sanctioning body in Scheduled Areas.
questions.s: Shankar IAS pp. 20-22

questions.q:
A CAG performance audit of 2023 on grain storage was cited in February 2026. With reference to this, consider the following statements:
1. The audit favoured phasing out Cover and Plinth storage in favour of scientific storage.
2. Under Article 151, the CAG's Union accounts reports go to the President, who causes them to be laid before Parliament.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Both are correct. Cover and Plinth storage is open stacking on plinths under waterproof covers, and it exposes grain to weather and pests, hence the call to augment scientific capacity. Article 151 sets the route for reports on Union accounts to reach Parliament, where the Public Accounts Committee usually examines them. The World's Largest Grain Storage Plan is one current response to this deficit.
questions.s: Vision IAS pp. 59-61; Article 151 and CAP meaning are static

questions.q:
The National Cooperation Policy 2025 seeks multipurpose societies in all panchayats. With reference to the constitutional position of cooperatives, consider the following statements:
1. The 97th Amendment Act, 2011 inserted Part IXB on co-operative societies.
2. The right to form co-operative societies is in Article 19(1)(c).
3. Article 43B directs the State to promote co-operative societies.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: All three are correct, and all came from the 2011 amendment. It added cooperatives to the freedom of association, a Directive Principle and a separate Part. However, in 2021 the Supreme Court struck down Part IXB so far as it governs State-level societies, because that subject lies in the State List, and the Part now survives for multi-State societies. PACS computerisation is a parallel reform.
questions.s: Vision IAS pp. 33-67; Shankar IAS pp. 54-57; Article provisions and 2021 ruling are static

questions.q:
With reference to scholarships for Scheduled Tribe students mentioned in a Rajya Sabha statement, consider the following statements:
1. The Centre-State funding ratio is 90:10 for North-Eastern and specified hill States and UTs.
2. The pre-matric scholarship covers Classes I to VIII.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 1 is correct; for other States the sharing is 75:25, and UTs without a legislature receive full central funding. Statement 2 is wrong because the pre-matric scholarship covers Classes IX and X, with different monthly rates for day scholars and hostellers. Both pre-matric and post-matric schemes apply a parental income ceiling of Rs 2.50 lakh a year, and States or UTs implement them.
questions.s: Shankar IAS pp. 20-22

questions.q:
With reference to other Ministry of Tribal Affairs support listed for Odisha, consider the following statements:
1. Tribal Research Institutes receive central funds for research, documentation and training.
2. Aid to Voluntary Organisations supports projects such as residential schools, hostels and mobile dispensaries.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Both are correct. The Institutes receive central support for infrastructure, research and documentation, training and capacity building, so tribal policy rests on local knowledge. Aid to voluntary organisations reaches remote areas through non-government partners in education and health, including small hospitals and livelihood projects. Each of these complements larger saturation schemes such as Dharti Aaba and PM JANMAN, which fill infrastructure gaps.
questions.s: Shankar IAS pp. 20-22

questions.q:
Arrange the following tribal development measures in chronological order of their beginning:
1. Special Central Assistance to the Tribal Sub-Plan
2. Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan
3. PM JANMAN
4. Setting up of the National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation
Select the correct order using the code given below.
questions.e: The order is 1977-78, 2001, 2023 and 2024. Special Central Assistance came first as a planning-era additive to State efforts. The finance corporation added a dedicated lender in 2001. PM JANMAN followed in late 2023 for vulnerable groups, and Dharti Aaba came in 2024 as a broader convergence push. The shift is from separate allocations towards time-bound saturation across villages and groups.
questions.s: Shankar IAS pp. 20-22; launch years of PM JANMAN and Dharti Aaba are static
